# Build the STAR genome index

## Match the index to the workflow mode

For `runall --mode star`, `--index` must point to a STAR `genomeDir`. Do not supply a Salmon index, FASTA file, or GTF file directly to `runall`.

This tutorial uses matching files from GENCODE human release 36:

- [GRCh38 primary assembly genome FASTA](https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_36/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz)
- [GENCODE v36 annotation GTF](https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_36/gencode.v36.annotation.gtf.gz)

## Build the index

```bash
mkdir -p reference/gencode-v36 reference/star-gencode-v36

wget -c \
  https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_36/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz \
  -O reference/gencode-v36/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz
wget -c \
  https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_36/gencode.v36.annotation.gtf.gz \
  -O reference/gencode-v36/gencode.v36.annotation.gtf.gz

gzip -dk reference/gencode-v36/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz
gzip -dk reference/gencode-v36/gencode.v36.annotation.gtf.gz

STAR \
  --runMode genomeGenerate \
  --runThreadN 4 \
  --genomeDir reference/star-gencode-v36 \
  --genomeFastaFiles reference/gencode-v36/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa \
  --sjdbGTFfile reference/gencode-v36/gencode.v36.annotation.gtf \
  --sjdbOverhang 100
```

This creates:

```text
reference/
├── gencode-v36/
│   ├── GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa
│   └── gencode.v36.annotation.gtf
└── star-gencode-v36/
    ├── Genome
    ├── SA
    ├── SAindex
    └── genomeParameters.txt
```

`--sjdbOverhang 100` matches 101-base reads. For another read length, set this value to read length minus one.

## Check the index

```bash
test -s reference/star-gencode-v36/Genome
test -s reference/star-gencode-v36/genomeParameters.txt
STAR --version | tee reference/star-version.txt
```

The index uses a complete human genome because downstream immune and ligand-receptor analyses require broad gene coverage. A small artificial genome would be fast but would invalidate most of the teaching workflow.
